sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: Candidate faithfully encodes the ship-targeted conditional requirement using the canonical controlled ice classification and an inclusive 0.7 m to 1.2 m ice-thickness range.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Remove gen:IceTypeClassificationShape. The requirement is conditional and does not independently require every ship to have an iceTypeClassification value; the SPARQL target already correctly applies the thickness constraint to ships explicitly classified as nltl:mediumFirstYearIce.
